stories.title: Council tax and cuts alone will not close Flintshire’s £22m budget gap, cabinet hears
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council cannot currently rule out issuing a Section 114 notice, cabinet has been told, as it faces a budget gap of up to £22 million for 2027-28. stories.title: Police Federation disputes arrest figures for North Wales force after national news investigation
stories.summary: North Wales Police had the second highest proportion of officers who made no arrests last year among forces examined by a national newspaper investigation. stories.title: Senedd hears warning over cancelled operations at Glan Clwyd
stories.summary: Cancer patients at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd are facing longer waits for surgery after an MS told the Senedd that four to five operations a day are being cancelled at the hospital, despite full staffing and consultants ready to operate. stories.title: Dan Thomas steps down as Reform Wales leader
stories.summary: Dan Thomas MS will step down as leader of Reform Wales. The party leader, who was elected to the Senedd in May, made the announcement this afternoon. stories.title: Letby: Thirlwall Inquiry finds “complete failure” to protect babies at Countess of Chester
stories.summary: A public inquiry into the deaths and attacks on babies at the Countess of Chester Hospital has found there was a “complete failure to protect babies” on the neonatal unit between 2015 and 2018.
